SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Egg Roll and Swan Balance, part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two CREATIVE ACTIVITIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENTS.

Key inquiry question: How do you perform egg rolls? 2. Why is it necessary to mark performing areas when performing swan balances?

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Egg Roll and Swan Balance together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
